document.abstract: The Abekas A84 Digital Post Production switcher is designed to be integrated into a CCIR 601 Component Digital editing environment. The A84 has 8 compositing layers each capable of performing two separate keys. Utilizing ASPIK™ Adaptive Sub-Pixel Intelligent Keying the A84 will ensure that the key edges are free from stair stepping.
